edges.description: Chronic tobacco-carcinogen exposure drives the bronchial squamous metaplasia-dysplasia field that precedes invasive squamous cell lung carcinoma, placing smoking as the initiating step upstream of the premalignant-field node.

An elevated alveolar type 2 age gap predicts incident lung cancer years before diagnosis. The link to the transformation node rests on alveolar type 2 cells being the cell of origin for lung adenocarcinoma, so an aged alveolar stem-cell compartment is a plausible substrate for driver-mutation acquisition - but the study measures a plasma protein signature, and does not show that the age gap predicts any specific driver lesion.

nodes.description: Chronic tobacco-carcinogen exposure produces a field of bronchial squamous metaplasia and dysplasia — the endobronchial precursor lesions of invasive squamous cell lung carcinoma. Reduced airway prostacyclin (PGI2) signaling characterizes this premalignant epithelium, and its pharmacologic restoration can reverse dysplasia, providing the rationale for prostacyclin-analogue interception before invasive transformation.

evidence.reference_title: Oral iloprost improves endobronchial dysplasia in former smokers.
evidence.snippet: We carried out a multicenter double-blind, randomized, phase II placebo-controlled trial of oral iloprost in current or former smokers with sputum cytologic atypia or endobronchial dysplasia.

nodes.description: Oral iloprost, a stable prostacyclin (PGI2) analogue, is an investigational chemopreventive ("interception") agent for bronchial premalignancy. Prostacyclin signaling is low in the dysplastic airway, and its restoration reverses endobronchial dysplasia. In a phase II placebo-controlled trial, oral iloprost significantly improved endobronchial histology in former smokers (with no benefit in current smokers), supporting further study of lung-cancer interception in this high-risk population.

evidence.snippet: The discovery of activating mutations in the epidermal growth factor receptor and anaplastic lymphoma kinase positivity has made personalized treatment for NSCLC more feasible.

nodes.description: Cigarette smoking is the dominant risk factor for lung carcinoma and drives carcinogenesis through chronic exposure to tobacco carcinogens.

evidence.snippet: Lung cancer is the leading cause of cancer deaths in both men and women, with 80-90% of cases caused by smoking.
